title: Single-name move screen 2026-11-06 (router-gated): 63 passed, index-only while B is gated
body_md: Router-gated single-name move screen for session 2026-11-06 (prior 2026-11-05), written by D1 2026-11-08 hosted inline by OPS2. 1971 names measured on Nasdaq discovery closes, 279 at >=5%. 67 carried an own-event EDGAR filing in the reaction window and were measured on IBKR daily bars: 63 passed (>=5% on IBKR), 4 dropped below 5% on IBKR, 0 unmeasured. Compact rejections: ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED 89, DAY2_EVENT_PRIOR 125, POST_MOVE_EVENT 2. B reads DO-NOT-ACTIVATE (held pending div-B-202611-2), so passes go to the new-entry index only; no thesis handoff. No metered call.

fields.legacy_rule: move >= 5% close-to-close (Strategy B frozen Entry criterion 1; mechanical record-only benchmark; legacy_rule_pass=true on every item here)
fields.selection_rule: Symbol list and marketCap from the key-less Nasdaq screener (its pctchange not used): 2107 rows with marketCap >= $2B, 111 non-common lines (preferreds, notes, baby bonds, warrants, units, depositary-interest lines) excluded by name; 1996 symbols fetched on api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/<SYM>/info and 1971 carried a regular-session close dated Nov 6, 2026 after 10 closed-end-fund/preferred-ADS lines were dropped by stockType (prior close = close minus netChange; discovery only); 279 were >=5% on that basis. Names >=4.5% were labelled from the key-less Nasdaq earnings calendar (schedule only) and one scripted EDGAR data.sec.gov/submissions batch (8-K items 1.01/2.02/4.02/7.01/8.01 or 6-K, acceptanceDateTime; reaction window = accepted after 2026-11-05 21:00Z to 2026-11-06 21:00Z; after-close = before 05:00Z 11-06, anchor 2026-11-05; pre-open 05:00Z-14:30Z and intraday to 21:00Z anchor 2026-11-06); no Tavily, web_search, WebFetch or FMP call was made for this screen. Filing text was read for in-window filings that are not an Item 2.02 earnings 8-K; filings that do not explain the move went to ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. Layer 2 measured all 67 reaction-window names on IBKR regular-session daily bars (close array, ONE_DAY, outside_rth=false, 16 bars; search_contracts paced under 25/min) in two sequential batches; prior_qualifying_* counts other >=5% IBKR close-to-close sessions in the 10 sessions 2026-10-23..2026-11-05; conviction ladder: >=3 prior => 30, 2 prior => 45, else |move|>=15 => 75, >=10 => 60, else 45. Source limit: free primary sources only (router-gated), so a name with no own filing in the window is ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. Session 2026-11-06 screened by OPS2 hosting the 2026-11-08 D1 inline.
